name: Para
line: Hosted or self-hosted JSON API with search, cache, auth, and webhooks.

free.text: 1 app, up to 10,000 objects; 90 idle days may delete data

cells.regions: AWS US, EU, or Japan; exact region unclear

sql.math: €25 is the known plan subtotal if app data fits 10 GB. Object count, request and transfer costs are unknown.
€25 a month continues when idle, if billable data stays within 10 GB. Actual indexed storage and other costs are unclear.

files.math: Para Cloud has no published hosted file storage plan.

jobs.math: €25 is the known app part. Webhook workers need separate hosting, and they have no published price for running time.
